posts.title: Invasive AI crawlers: what happened to manners?
posts.description: When Aaron Swartz cached a bunch of journal articles he was entitled to read for free , he was relentlessly prosecuted. When AI companies ravenously scrape the whole web, they get off scot-free and the bill goes to the sites they scraped. posts.title: Obsidian-LiveSync: Self-Hosted (mostly)
posts.description: Self-hosted Obsidian LiveSync using CouchDB on Proxmox LXC container, secured with Tailscale VPN and end-to-end encryption. Proxmox VM / Container Host I have Proxmox VE 9.1 running on an old (circa 2013) laptop. It has USB 3 ports, but only USB 2 seems to work for booting from a thumb drive.
